title: Effects of proline substitution/inclusion on the nanostructure of a self-assembling β-sheet-forming peptide
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37419-37430
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07065H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jacek K. Wychowaniec, Martin Šrejber, Niting Zeng, Andrew M. Smith, Aline F. Miller, Michal Otyepka, Alberto Saiani
Self-assembling peptides remain persistently interesting objects for constructing defined nanostructures. By strategically incorporating proline, we can precisely control the resulting structures, ranging from flat nanoribbons to twisted nanofibers.
